description: German employment law, Germany only. Checklist of the formal requirements when an employer gives notice (Kündigung durch den Arbeitgeber), each item with its legal norm: written form, receipt (Zugang), notice period, works council hearing, special protection (Sonderkündigungsschutz), small business without the Kündigungsschutzgesetz up to 10 employees, 3-week deadline for a claim, Arbeitsbescheinigung, reference (Zeugnis), remaining holiday. Use it before a dismissal.
